com.billy.glassmusic.name: Music
com.billy.glassmusic.subtitle: Your music. Offline.
com.billy.glassmusic.localizedDescription: A native offline music player with songs, albums, playlists, local search, editable artwork, and Liquid Glass controls. Version 0.10 adds all 15 Cask 3 scrolling presets in Settings.

com.billy.voiceglass.name: VoiceGlass
com.billy.voiceglass.subtitle: Create with your voice. On your iPhone.
com.billy.voiceglass.localizedDescription: Native on-device voice cloning and text-to-speech, reference recording/import, saved voices and clips, playback and WAV export. Download compatible Core ML models once, then create locally. Built device IPA; physical-iPhone inference validation is still required.

com.billy.prism.name: Prism
com.billy.prism.subtitle: Your imagination. On your iPhone.
com.billy.prism.localizedDescription: Native AI image generation and reference-image editing with Generate, Edit, Gallery and Settings tabs. FLUX.2 Klein and Z-Image Turbo run through MLX and Metal with separately downloaded models. Built device IPA; physical-iPhone inference validation is still required.

com.billy.moonhop.name: Moonhop
com.billy.moonhop.subtitle: A little moonlit adventure.
com.billy.moonhop.localizedDescription: An offline landscape pixel-art platformer with touch controls, jumping, checkpoints, collectibles, and a moonlit world.

com.billy.depthcheck.name: Depth Check
com.billy.depthcheck.subtitle: Convert photos and videos to 3D
com.billy.depthcheck.localizedDescription: Convert photos and videos into 3D on your iPhone. Export Apple Spatial, side-by-side, over-under and other stereo formats at the original pixel dimensions and video frame timing. Includes two offline depth models. HDR video is converted to SDR.
